Name: (EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for Cornucopia More Flowers - BAGI Successor
Author: klhumphrey918
Description:
This mod is developed in the style of, and intended to be used alongside, the amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]. By utilizing [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url]﻿, you will add custom textures in [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/cometkins/]cometkins[/url]' style for your [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url] artisan good items, in this case honey. 


[u]Recommended Mods:[/u]

This mod is intended to be paired with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Chocoronron/mods]Chocoronron[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39269]Cornucopia More Flowers Cometkins Style[/url]﻿. The color selections in my mod are intended to best match up with the retextures of this mod, so I recommend you consider downloading it in order bring a pretty, toned down look to all your Cornucopia-More Flowers objects. 


[u]Installation Instructions:[/u]

1) Install "Even Better Artisan Good Icons" mod to your mod folder. This mod is required for my content pack to function.
2) ﻿Install this mod to your mod folder.
3) Launch the game and enjoy seeing retextures that match the rest of the Better Artisan Goods art style. Enjoy!


My EBAGI retextures in cometkins style:
[list]
[*]Ridgeside Village, found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30871](EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for RSV[/url]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded, found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30850](EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for SVE[/url]
[*]Cornucopia - More Flowers, found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39727](EBAGI) Better Artisan goods for CMF[/url]
[*]Cornucopia - More Crops, found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39803](EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for CMC[/url]﻿﻿﻿
[/list]
Thanks for taking a look, friends. Enjoy the valley!﻿ - K
